descricao_original: Identifying specific stages of erythrocyte and granulocyte development is very difficult in tissue sections of bone marrow. That task is much easier using bone marrow smears. Several stages of erythrocyte and granulocyte development are visible in this image, each process will be described in greater detail in the following images. 400x
